text: In light of our sister office's successful migration on the same platform last spring, it would be prudent for the firm to consider migrating to the new records platform. Additionally, the vendor's offer of an audited rollback path ensures that any potential issues can be addressed seamlessly, providing peace of mind throughout the transition process. Furthermore, the automated cross-linking feature offered by the new system stands out as a unique advantage not available elsewhere, enhancing operational efficiency. Combining these benefits with cost savings through reduced combined license fees further justifies the move towards this new records platform.
